275880026.description:
Natural History Specimen
Petrified Wood Fossil
Ancient Mineralized Wood, Natural Earth Tones
This specimen of petrified wood represents a significant geological event where organic plant material was replaced by minerals, typically silica, over millions of years. The resulting fossil retains much of the original cellular structure and growth patterns of the source wood, now transformed into a dense, mineralized material. This particular piece features a unique, abstract form with a tapered, beak-like projection that lends it a sculptural quality suitable for diverse display environments.
Authentic mineralized petrified wood specimen with complex surface textures
Displays a range of warm reddish-brown and ochre tones characteristic of iron mineralization
Unique organic silhouette resembling an abstract avian form or skull
Measures 9 inches in length and weighs 1.22 pounds
Condition:
Good natural condition for a geological specimen. The piece features inherent natural irregularities, surface pitting, and textural variations consistent with the fossilization process. Some areas show smooth, dense mineralization while others retain a more fibrous appearance. No evidence of modern repairs or synthetic enhancements. Stable and suitable for shelf or cabinet display.
